results.title: Nigeria accounts for 25% of global maternal deaths – UN
results.content: The United Nations (UN) said Nigeria accounts for 25 per cent of maternal deaths recorded globally. It also said one in 22 Nigerian women risks dying during pregnancy and childbirth.
